title: A1 II 4.00: C3 steps the rear-screen preview 3:2 -> 2:1 -> 2.25:1 -> 2.4:1 in movie mode and keeps the focus frames: VDF words and the frame widgets' expected rectangle, written from appFw
ported_from: lcdcycle_v7 (A7 IV 6.02; v6 works on that camera, F858, F969; v7 in the F989 baseline) in the form of lcdcycle_zv_v1 / lcdcycle_c2_v1; the split-entry rule from lcdcycle_s3_v1 (A7S III 5.01; ran on that camera)
write_order: the patches in the listed order to apply (cave, then the hook); the reverse order to put back

triggers.0x2150006: EVENT_INPUT_KEY_TACT_CUSTOM3_ON (C3, as on the A7 IV)

cave.old_bytes: zero: the 16-aligned tail of the first (r-x) segment's last page, past its file size; mapped with the page, as the A7 IV's cave

frame_rectangles.note: {x, y, w, h} u16 in a 640x480 grid, row 1 (rear panel) column 3 (16:9 picture) of the three tables; the widgets accept 5 units either way. 3:2, 2:1 and 2.4:1 are the values that work on the A7 IV (F969); 2.25:1 is (0, 80, 640, 320) by the same rule. build/emu_lcd_a1m2.py runs the A1 II's own picture-ratio function with each state's words and its AF-window check 0x128530 against these entries on 1024 x 682 and 720 x 480: all accepted. The entry 0xf8247c lies across two 64-byte lines (0xf8247c / 0xf82480): both halves or neither

goes_with: an A1 II open-gate state whose live view is a 16:9 frame holding the whole 3:2 area (as the A7 IV's)
lcdfill_a1m2_v1 (fit word 0x1faca4 = 0 and the three entries at the 3:2 rectangle): without the fill word a press does nothing
not_checked: on a camera: nothing of this design has run on an A1 II

that the key labelled C3 sends 0x2150006 (the name record and id are the A7 IV's, where C3 = 0x2150006 was seen on the camera; the A1 II's table has CUSTOM, CUSTOM2, CUSTOM3, CUSTOM5 and CUSTOM6 and the body has C1-C4)
that system mode 3 is movie on this camera (the accessor is found by call position; its field offset differs from the A7 IV's)
that dlsym(RTLD_DEFAULT) finds libsencore's three functions in im.elf (the names are exported by this build's libsencore.so)
that the rear panel reports panel code 1 (3:2) and that the frame widgets use row 1 for it (the A1 II's check 0x128530 asks 0x693b0e)
the remote-send (0x128d50) and tracking (0x1297d8) widgets' checks were not emulated (same tables and rectangles)
that the picture-ratio flag (bit 0 of its fourth argument; 1 selects 100/235) is 0 in the open-gate state, as on the A7S III
with the camera's own De-Squeeze Display on, VDF uses its calculator 0x1fae78 instead of the picture-ratio function: the cycle's picture words then have no effect (keep De-Squeeze Display off)
the viewfinder: not handled (as on the A7 IV); it stays letterboxed and squeezed
note: put back (level 20) removes the code; the coprocessor words stay in the mode last chosen until a cold boot. In movie mode the C3 key's assigned function no longer runs (the press is turned into the ignored event); in stills C3 is normal
